# Holden Stirling Ottolini

## About
Holden Ottolini is a Senior Solutions Architect at Writer, covering enterprise accounts in the West region. He runs technical pre-sales: discovery, solution design, proofs of concept, and integration planning with customer architecture and IT teams. He also takes on select outside consulting work.

## Background
Before Writer, Holden co-founded Arc4, a systems integrator he grew from zero to 17 people with 50+ enterprise implementations. Before that he spent 8 years at Yext, promoted 5 times from Enterprise Sales Coordinator to Senior Solutions Architect, with multiple President's Club years. He led one of the largest healthcare provider search deployments in Yext's history. He has worked in New York City, Washington D.C., and Denver.

## Consulting
- Pre-sales and solutions engineering, including fractional solutions architect work
- Platform and vendor advisory: enterprise collaboration (Zoom, Microsoft Teams), digital identity and e-signature, web platforms
- Website and CMS projects: WordPress, Contentful, Sanity, Drupal, Webflow, Shopify, Next.js
- Search and local visibility
- Expert network calls on enterprise software, collaboration, identity, and website infrastructure

## Skills
Solution architecture, technical pre-sales, enterprise implementation, integrations and APIs, AWS and Azure, Python, TypeScript, React, Next.js.

## Side Projects
- Local Visibility Audit: free tool scoring a business across search, directories, reviews, and SEO (https://holdenottolini.com/ai-audit)
- Resume Coach: hiring-manager style resume review (https://holdenottolini.com/resume-coach)
- Multi Platform CMS Connector, Local Content Engine, Search Quality Evaluator (https://github.com/holdenstirling)

## Speaking
Spoke at Localogy L25 and has appeared as a podcast guest. Topics: enterprise pre-sales and proofs of concept, implementation at scale, building a company from zero, and what endurance sports teach about work.

## Personal
5x Ironman finisher. Mountaineer and backcountry skier. Traveled solo through 15 countries over 90 days. Started his first business at 12 selling pumpkins in upstate Pennsylvania. Binghamton University graduate.

## Location
Denver, Colorado
